name: Startup Application Manager
description: Watches for programs that add themselves to startup and lets you approve or block them.
author: AETHER

settings.label: Notify me when a program adds itself to startup
Disable new startup programs until I approve them
settings.description: New per-user entries are disabled the same way Task Manager disables them; machine-wide entries are reported but need administrator rights to change. Re-enable them in Applications ▸ Startup.

documentation.whatItChanges: Reads HKCU/HKLM Run keys and the Startup folders. Blocking writes the StartupApproved value (the Task Manager mechanism).
